label: PLANET GS-4210-24P2S (hardware version 4)
description: PLANET GS-4210-24P2S managed Gigabit PoE+ switch (hardware version 4): 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T 802.3af/at PoE+ RJ45 (30 W a port), 2x 100/1000/2500BASE-X SFP uplinks, 370 W PoE budget, 58 Gbps non-blocking fabric, 43.1 Mpps, two fans 1U.

poe.note: 370 W PoE budget on the hardware version 4 datasheet. 802.3af/802.3at PSE, 30 W max a port at 54 V DC, 600 mA. The PD table allows 24 units at 7 W, 24 at 15.4 W and only 12 at 30 W, which is what a 370 W budget buys.

fabric.note: 58 Gbps non-blocking fabric and 43.1 Mpps at 64 bytes, 16K MAC table, 4.1 Mbit buffer, 12K jumbo frames. Not 48 Gbps because two of the cages are 2.5G.

notes: Hardware version 4 (datasheet v4.0 dated 2026-01-23). Ports 1-24 are copper PoE+, cages 25-26 take 100/1000/2500BASE-X, RJ45 console at 115200 8-N-1, two fans, 440 x 207 x 44 mm, 2.6 kg, 425 W max fully loaded. Discrepancy: the GS-4210 Series Quick Installation Guide v1.11 lists the 24P2S at 300 W, and the earlier hardware revisions were 220 W/300 W; the current v4 board is a 370 W unit with 2.5G uplinks, and that is what is modelled.
